name: io.github.jaylann/mcp-server-sevdesk
title: sevDesk
description: Safety-first MCP server for sevDesk accounting: invoices, receipts, banking, reports. Unofficial.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: sevDesk API token (Settings > Users > API token). It has full access to the account; ideally create it for a dedicated user. To keep it out of the client configuration, set up the server by hand with SEVDESK_API_TOKEN_KEYCHAIN (OS keychain) or SEVDESK_API_TOKEN_FILE instead: https://sevdeskmcp.lanfermann.dev/docs/en/configuration#token

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated permission tiers to enable: read, write, commit, external, or all. Tools above the allowed tiers are not registered. read is always on.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow only read tools, whatever SEVDESK_ALLOW says.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to make write tools only return a preview of what they would do, without sending anything.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_CONFIRM
environmentVariables.description: How a human confirms commit and external actions: elicit (in the client), browser (local approval page) or off (also needs SEVDESK_I_UNDERSTAND_NO_CONFIRM=1).

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of a local JSON Lines file that records every write the server makes (redacted). Unset: no audit log.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to load, e.g. invoices,vouchers,banking. Unset loads all except advanced; all adds advanced.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_FILE_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Absolute folders (separated like PATH) that receipts and e-invoices may be read from, for voucher uploads and e-invoice import. Unset: no local file is read.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder where PDFs, e-invoice XML, CSV and DATEV exports may be saved. Unset: the file-saving tools are not offered.

packageArguments.description: Serve MCP over stdio (the image's default command is --http).

To keep it out of the client configuration, run the image by hand with SEVDESK_API_TOKEN_FILE and a mounted secret file instead: https://sevdeskmcp.lanfermann.dev/docs/en/configuration#token

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated permission tiers to enable: read, write, commit, external, or all. Tools above the allowed tiers are not registered. read is always on.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow only read tools, whatever SEVDESK_ALLOW says.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to make write tools only return a preview of what they would do, without sending anything.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_CONFIRM
environmentVariables.description: How a human confirms commit and external actions: elicit (in the client) or off (also needs SEVDESK_I_UNDERSTAND_NO_CONFIRM=1). The browser mode's local approval page is not reachable from outside the container.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path inside the container (on a mounted, writable volume) of a JSON Lines file that records every write the server makes (redacted). Unset: no audit log.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to load, e.g. invoices,vouchers,banking. Unset loads all except advanced; all adds advanced.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_FILE_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Absolute folders inside the container (separated by colons) that receipts and e-invoices may be read from; mount them into the container. Unset: no local file is read.

environmentVariables.name: SEVDESK_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder inside the container (mount it, writable) where PDFs, e-invoice XML, CSV and DATEV exports may be saved. Unset: the file-saving tools are not offered.
